---
title: "Who Moved to Sarasota County?"
format:
  html:
    toc: true
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

library(tidyverse)
library(jsonlite)

reporter_url <- "https://api.censusreporter.org/1.0/data/show/acs2024_1yr"

get_table <- \(table_id) {
  url <- paste0(reporter_url,
                "?table_ids=", table_id,
                "&geo_ids=05000US12115")

  data <- fromJSON(url, simplifyVector = TRUE)

  list(
    estimates = data$data[[1]][[table_id]]$estimate,
    errors = data$data[[1]][[table_id]]$error,
    columns = data$tables[[table_id]]$columns
  )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-data
#| include: false

age_table <- get_table("B07001")

age_groups <- c(
  "1 to 4 years", "5 to 17 years", "18 and 19 years",
  "20 to 24 years", "25 to 29 years", "30 to 34 years",
  "35 to 39 years", "40 to 44 years", "45 to 49 years",
  "50 to 54 years", "55 to 59 years", "60 to 64 years",
  "65 to 69 years", "70 to 74 years", "75 years and over"
)

movement_bases <- c(
  "Moved within same county",
  "Moved from different county within same state",
  "Moved from different state",
  "Moved from abroad"
)

starts <- c(34, 50, 66, 82)

age_data <- tibble(
  movement = rep(movement_bases, each = length(age_groups)),
  age = rep(age_groups, times = length(movement_bases)),
  column = paste0(
    "B070010",
    sprintf("%02d", unlist(map(starts, \(start) start:(start + 14))))
  )
) |>
  mutate(
    people = map_dbl(column, \(column) age_table$estimates[[column]])
  ) |>
  filter(people > 0)

movers_by_origin <- age_data |>
  group_by(movement) |>
  summarize(people = sum(people), .groups = "drop")

sex_table <- get_table("B07003")

sex_data <- tibble(
  movement = rep(movement_bases, each = 2),
  sex = rep(c("Male", "Female"), times = length(movement_bases)),
  column = c(
    "B07003008", "B07003009",
    "B07003011", "B07003012",
    "B07003014", "B07003015",
    "B07003017", "B07003018"
  )
) |>
  mutate(people = map_dbl(column, \(column) sex_table$estimates[[column]]))

```

## How many people moved where?

These estimates describe people who lived outside Sarasota County one year ago
and reported Sarasota County as their current residence.

```{r}
#| label: movers-by-origin
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(movers_by_origin, aes(x = fct_reorder(movement, people), y = people)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2c7fb8") +
  geom_text(aes(label = scales::comma(people)), hjust = -0.1, size = 4) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma,
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  labs(
    title = "People moving to Sarasota County, 2024",
    subtitle = "Residence one year ago, ACS 1-year estimates",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Estimated number of people"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13)
```

## Age of people moving

```{r}
#| label: age-movers
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

ggplot(age_data, aes(x = factor(age, levels = age_groups),
                     y = people,
                     fill = movement)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Age groups of people who moved to Sarasota County",
    subtitle = "2024 ACS 1-year estimates",
    x = "Age",
    y = "Estimated number of people",
    fill = "Where they moved from"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

## Sex of people moving

```{r}
#| label: sex-movers
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5

ggplot(sex_data, aes(x = movement, y = people, fill = sex)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set1") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Sex of people moving to Sarasota County",
    subtitle = "2024 ACS 1-year estimates",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Estimated number of people",
    fill = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 30, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom")
```

**Source:** U.S. Census Bureau, 2024 ACS 1-year estimates, accessed through
Census Reporter. Estimates have margins of error and should not be interpreted
as exact counts.
